mike_dev: heads-up: ran into a cert verify failure with the Python async client when talking to our Dedicated endpoint behind a local HTTP sidecar + corp CA. curl --cacert works but httpx in the sample app fails. :confused:

mike_dev: minimal async repro:
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(base_url="https://dedicated.internal:8443", api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
await client.chat.create("hi")
```

mike_dev: container mounts /etc/ssl/corp-root.pem. `curl --cacert /etc/ssl/corp-root.pem https://dedicated.internal:8443/health` -> 200. httpx stack: `ssl.SSLError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed`

tara_sdk: likely trust_env + proxy interception issue. httpx picks up HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY and REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE via trust_env, which can lead to the proxy re-tlsing and a mismatch unless you trust the proxy CA. Also httpx uses its own SSLContext.

tara_sdk: quick workaround I use in examples:
```py
import ssl
ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
ctx.load_verify_locations('/etc/ssl/corp-root.pem')
client = AsyncClient(base_url='https://dedicated.internal:8443', api_key=..., ssl=ctx, trust_env=False)
```

mike_dev: that fixes the handshake locally. two things to flag: (1) docs onboarding only show base_url + api_key and no guidance for proxies/custom CAs, (2) our retry middleware is currently retrying on SSL errors which makes logs noisy (backoff + masked cause).

alex_docs: good catch. we'll add a focused "Dedicated / Private: proxies & custom CA (async)" snippet to onboarding. include the exact gist, a tiny docker-compose example, and a short checklist: mount CA, set REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE for sync requests, and for async flows either pass ssl.SSLContext or set trust_env=False. also show the curl success vs httpx failure to help debugging.

nate_sre: regarding retries : verification failures are not transient. i'll open an issue to change the retry predicate so ssl.SSLError during verification is non-retryable and emits a clear "non-retryable SSL verification failure" log.

tara_sdk: small SDK fixes i'm planning: (a) accept ssl: Optional[ssl.SSLContext] in AsyncClient ctor and reflect that in .pyi/stubs, (b) type AsyncClient.__aenter__ to return the concrete AsyncClient type for better mypy UX, (c) add a unit test that mocks ssl.SSLError and asserts zero retries.

mike_dev: i'll author the docs PR with the repro app under examples/dedicated-proxy-ca (tiny Dockerfile + compose) and include both the httpx traceback and the working curl command plus all env vars I used (HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE). i'll link it here when ready.

alex_docs: cc @docs to help phrase the blurb without too much TLS jargon. keep it checklist-style and include the exact code snippet.

mike_dev: thanks everyone! saved a lot of debugging time. :tada:
